crm_notes: Topline: national healthcare payments processor that routes insurance claims and patient payments. Heavy PCI + PHI scope — wants VPC/private with strict retention + auditability.
Primary ask: agent assist for contact center (live tool-calls to billing systems), automatic ticket summarization to reduce AHT, reliable inference during monthly billing spikes.
"Agent quote": "If we miss authorization windows during end-of-month batches our CS load doubles — need predictable tail latency under load."
Preference: model candidates must be pinned; will require fallback routing to smaller quantized variant to meet SLOs during spikes.
Data flow: tokens may include masked PHI, full card PANs must never be stored; plan to tokenize at edge and use token-key references in VPC only.
Security: SOC2 + HIPAA are must-haves; expect vendor security questionnaire and penetration test window. Want KMS integration for token store and audit log shipping to Splunk.
Notes on cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for predictability; focused on unit economics vs. SLA breaches, interested in Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
Integration targets: legacy billing (MedBillPro v3) via tool-calls, Salesforce Service Cloud for ticketing, internal SSO (Okta).
Legal: requires BAA + PCI addendum; procurement timeline tied to Q3 budget approvals.

use_case_summary: Agent assist: context-aware response suggestions, tool-calling to MedBillPro for status checks and payment authorizations.
Ticket summarization: canonical short summary + categorical tags (billing, insurance, technical) to auto-route and reduce handle time.
Reranking for knowledge retrieval: high-precision reranker to surface policy docs, billing rules during agent sessions.
Reliability: predictable tail latency target 95th < 250ms for suggestion generation under steady state, throttled fallback under spikes to quantized model with 150ms median.
technical_requirements: VPC-private deployment with customer-managed control plane; no outbound model artifacts to public internet.
KMS integration (AWS KMS + HSM key wrap) for tokenization keys and model cache encryption.
Audit logging with immutable append-only logs shipped to Splunk; 7-year retention for payment-related interactions.
SAML SSO (Okta) with SCIM user sync and role-based access controls for console and API keys.
Ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback routing policies for capacity-managed bursts.
Support for tool-calls with strict auth scopes and redaction policies for PHI/CARD data in transcripts.
poc_plan: 6-week VPC POC: week1 infra + SSO; week2 model onboarding + secure tokenization; week3 agent-assist pilot with synthetic tickets; week4 load test for monthly-billing spike emulation; week5 observability validation (audit logs + tracing); week6 review + handoff.
Success metrics: reduce AHT by 18-25%, 99.9% no-PAN retention in logs, 95th percentile latency goals met for suggestions under 200ms in steady state.
Deliverables: infra IaC, security runbook, performance report, handoff checklist for Dedicated/Private deployment.
